sources.snippet: Overview Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Thinking is a reasoning-augmented language model built by JetBrains that emits explicit chain-of-thought reasoning before generating final answers. The model uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 64 experts and activates 8 experts per token, resulting in 2.5B active parameters despite 12B total parameters. It combines sliding-window and full attention layers ...
